subtasks.title: Locate authoritative evidence
subtasks.prompt: Search for primary company or SEC sources relevant to the dated financial question.
subtasks.success_criterion: At least one authoritative source URL or filing is identified.

subtasks.title: Retrieve and analyze evidence
subtasks.prompt: Parse selected evidence and retrieve the exact facts, dates, units, and calculations needed by the question.
subtasks.success_criterion: The stored evidence supports every material part of the answer.

subtasks.title: Synthesize and submit
subtasks.prompt: Give a concise answer with exact figures and source URLs, then submit it once.
subtasks.success_criterion: A non-empty sourced answer is submitted for judging.
